scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the canonical orthonormal-coordinate simplex-plus-segment pentasm with all real t>0 and d>=3, not arbitrary affine deformations or t=0. Historical priority remains provisional and no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Exact minimum enclosing spheres and diametral rigidity of Euclidean pentasms
